senses.gloss:
1. दुह् दुह् (originally दुघ्, cf. दुघ), ii. 2, and i. 4.
 I. Par.
 1. To milk, Man. 8, 231; Bhāg. P. 4, 17, 7; to milk out (with two accs.), 4, 18, 18.
 2. To enjoy, Ragh. 1, 26.
 3. To practise from interested motives, MBh. 3, 1165.
 4. To draw something out of anything (with two accs.), MBh. 12, 3305; with acc. and abl., Man. 1, 23.
 II. Ātm.
 1. To yield milk or other desired objects, MBh. 1, 6658; 6657 (also i. 4, Par., Bhāg. P. i, 14, 19). Anomal. 3 pl. of the red. pf. दुदूहुस्, on account of the metre, Bhāg. P. 5, 15, 9.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. दुग्ध,
 1. Milked. Hariv. 79.
 2. Impoverished, Daśak. in Chr. 192, 16.
 3. Collected, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 12. n. Milk. Bhartṛ. 2, 15.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. दोहय,
 1. To cause to yield milk or other desired objects, Bhāg. P. 4, 18, 15.
 2. To produce, Man. 2, 77. Desider. दुधुक्ष, To wish to milk or to enjoy, Bhartṛ. 2, 38.
 --With the prep. निस् निस्,
 1. To milk out, to produce, MBh. 2, 76.
 2. To withdraw, Kathās. 16, 83.
 --With सम् सम्, To milk, to enjoy, MBh. 12, 4384. (i. 4. Par.)
 --Cf. Goth. tiuhan; A.S. teon, teoge; O.H.G. ziuhan; Lat. duco; O.H.G. ziug (gaziug), zaugjan; τεῦχος.
† 2. दुह् दुह्, i. 1, Par. To give pain.

दुहितृ दुहितृ, i. e. दुह् + तृ, f. A daughter, Man. 2, 215. Anomal. acc. pl. दुहितरस्, Rām. 3, 20, 28.
 --Abstract. त्व त्व, n. Rām. 1, 44, 38.
 --Cf. θυγάτηρ; Goth. dauhtar; A.S. dohtor.
